title: Bibliography (v0)
description: Project-wide list of source references. Shipped as bibliography.json at the bundle root. Translated titles (when applicable) appear in locale files keyed by 'bibliography.<id>.title'. Vocabulary locked by ADR 0010.

id.description: Short stable identifier, author-chosen. Example: 'B1', 'A12', 'W3', 'I7'. First letter conventionally aligns with category (B=book, A=article, W=web, I=interview) but not enforced. Renamed from 'ref_key' per ADR 0010 to match Swift Source.id.

title.description: Original-language title. Translations live in locale files under 'bibliography.<id>.title'.

publisher.description: Publisher and place when applicable (e.g. 'Harper Perennial (London)').

year.description: Publication year as a string. Producers SHOULD emit a plain four-digit year when known ('1926'); MAY use ranges ('1878-1883'), approximations ('c.1900'), or empty string when unknown. String-only per ADR 0010.

category.description: Source type. Lowercase, locked vocabulary per ADR 0010. 'archive' covers archival scans/holdings (Wikimedia, museum archives, etc.) — meaningful for archival-heavy projects.

linked_stops.description: Stop slugs this source informs. Drives 'Sources' display per stop in the app.

linked_scenes.description: Scene IDs this source informs (when more specific than stop-level).
